transport: Connected GitHub Git-data API creates new commit metadata. Every published source/research tree equals its original local tree; the frozen receipt retains its original source revision. Original commits are preserved in the verified bundle.
scope: One fixed continuous R/tau box; independently reviewed all-prefix containment, availability and conditional width arguments; immutable retained SOC0/capacity evidence; five-case short falsification and unchanged retained-history C comparison.
proof_kind: Written independently reviewed source-operation arguments; not machine-checked, compiler-certified or target-qualified.
failure_scope: Renewed phase: R54mOhm/tau33s capacity width and SOC0 width sum do not shrink; R66mOhm/tau27s capacity width does not shrink. Original box, stimulus and gates preserved.

publication_metadata_review.method: Independent read-only review of publication provenance, handoff, state, report, commit map, bundle metadata and fetched Git-object relationships; no full receipt load or test rerun.
publication_metadata_review.confirmed: Tree identity, parent mapping, original source preservation, fetchable canonical reproduction revision and false overall acceptance with three usefulness leaf failures.
